snippet.title: Bubble Stomp | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
#AfilGames #BubbleStomp
🇧🇷🇵🇹
🚩💥 Uma aventura cheia de pulos, explosões e criatividade!
Em Bubble Stomp, cada obstáculo é uma oportunidade para testar suas habilidades e descobrir novas formas de avançar por fases repletas de desafios de plataforma. Combine bolhas, Ground Pound e canhões para criar movimentos criativos enquanto procura segredos e supera cada desafio.

🎮 Disponível a partir de 22 de setembro no Xbox, com 20% de desconto no lançamento!

🇺🇸🇬🇧
🚩💥 An adventure packed with jumps, explosions, and creativity!
In Bubble Stomp, every obstacle is an opportunity to test your skills and discover new ways to move through stages filled with exciting platforming challenges. Combine bubbles, Ground Pound, and cannons for creative movement while uncovering secrets and overcoming every challenge.

🎮 Available from September 22 on Xbox, with a 20% launch discount!

KEY FEATURES
🚩 Bounce, blast, and smash your way through obstacles;
🚩 Combine bubbles, Ground Pound, and cannons for creative movement;
🚩 Master 30 action-packed levels filled with secrets and challenges;

Grab Yours 
🎮 Xbox One: https://x.gd/tu2oi
🎮 Xbox Series: https://x.gd/xqvED
